stories.headline: Topstep adds Live tiers, Micro Bitcoin limits and a payout hold rule in November
stories.why: Topstep is on your watchlist and several November changes touch payouts and Live funding. These come from a third-party change tracker, not Topstep, so check Topstep's help pages before relying on them.
points: Nov 3: new 25K and 250K Live Funded tiers (25K: $1,000 daily loss limit, 3 lots; 250K: $5,000 daily loss limit, 15 lots)
Nov 9: profile holds pause purchases and payout requests during a 7-business-day review; profiles created during a hold are closed without refund
Nov 9: 80% Live Reserve can unlock in as few as 4 weeks; returning Live traders keep prior balance and reserve targets
Nov 10: Micro Bitcoin (MBT) limits of 5, 10 and 15 contracts on 50K, 100K and 150K accounts; Nov 12: 100K and 150K Static Drawdown Combines available at any time (limit 5 per account per month)
stories.next: No dated catalyst found; confirm effective dates and grandfathering on Topstep's help centre.

stories.headline: Pelacarsen cuts Lp(a) 78% but does not reduce heart attacks or strokes in NEJM trial
stories.why: The first big outcomes test of lowering Lp(a), a genetically set heart-risk factor, came back neutral, so Lp(a) lowering is not yet a proven way to cut events. Conventional risk-factor control stays the priority.
points: Lp(a)HORIZON: 8,350 patients with prior CV event and Lp(a) of 70 mg/dL or more; monthly 80 mg pelacarsen vs placebo, median 4.7 years.
Lp(a) fell 77.7% at 12 months; major CV events 12.3% vs 12.1%, HR 1.02 (95% CI 0.90-1.15).
Drug-related adverse events 56.8% vs 18.0%; discontinuations 20.6% vs 7.5%.
Novartis (funder) has discontinued the pelacarsen ASCVD programme; trials of olpasiran, lepodisiran and muvalaplin continue.
stories.next: Other Lp(a) outcomes trials (OCEAN(a)-Outcomes, ACCLAIM-Lp(a), MOVE-Lp(a)) are ongoing; no read-out date confirmed.
stories.study: Large phase 3 double-blind RCT (n=8,350, 42 countries), secondary-prevention patients only; result applies to pelacarsen, not other Lp(a) drugs, and not to primary prevention.
